Constant b produces P(Bin(t,b)≥d), giving a Φ window centered at d/b with sd sqrt(d(1-b))/b by CLT and concentration outside relative windows by LLN. Rates in fixed [c,C]⊂(0,1) give Lyapunov CLT with σ² proportional d. With single b1,d weak, H_d/d→1/b and independent geometric G1; if db1→∞ then G1/d→0; otherwise subsequences db1→κ≥0 yield nondegenerate shifted exponential ratio or pure Exp(1), proving iff. At b1=κ/d, CDF of d-scaled sum tends to zero until 1/b and shifted exponential after.
